purpose: Measure how much the already-observed v0.51 GLM/XGBoost frequency response-shape differences move under deterministic development-sample perturbations. This is interpretability stability, not predictive validation or candidate selection.

source.required_fields: frozen rating feature contract + year + total_exposure + total_claims

fold_design.assignment: deterministic NumPy Generator permutation of eligible 2022 source-row ordinals, then round-robin fold labels 0..4 over the permutation
fold_design.per_fold_fit_rows: all eligible 2022 rows except the assigned fold
fold_design.held_out_fold_role: sample-perturbation exclusion only; no held-out performance metric is computed

models.relativity_normalisation: each fold-fitted model is divided by its own prediction at the frozen v0.51 2022 reference profile

evaluation_grid.numeric: exact feature/quantile/value points persisted by v0.51
evaluation_grid.categorical: exact displayed feature/level points persisted by v0.51

preselected_review_points.reason: v0.51 high-age point has a large displayed GLM/XGBoost response-shape difference
v0.51 older-vehicle point has a large displayed GLM/XGBoost response-shape difference
v0.51 vehicle-value response is a deliberately smaller-gap counterexample

interpretation_rules.note: Five fixed development folds are a deterministic sample-perturbation diagnostic. Their range or standard deviation is not a sampling confidence interval and cannot clear any existing validation blocker.
